author: FRONTLINE PBS | Official
description:
Three years ago today, one of the deadliest wildfires in U.S. history began in Hawaii, reducing much of the town of Lahaina to ashes. Questions remain about the chaotic response to the tragedy, including if emergency sirens should have been activated.

FRONTLINE's 2024 documentary “Maui’s Deadly Firestorm” is now streaming on our YouTube channel.
title: Should Sirens Have Been Activated During Maui's Wildfire?
